Architectural VisualisationMedia Coverage 17.09.2007 1 min read

Back to the City and Architect Magazine

Andy CASA, UCL East

After a week away its back to the city and a return to the blog. Up and coming this week is a new section on Urban Gadgets with a look at the essential kit required to capture the urban environment. First up is the Power Monkey Explorer, a solar powered charger that will keep your Nokia N95 GPS or any other device charged while on the go. The section kicks off as soon as we have thoroughly tested out the kit.

As a side note Architect Magazine kindly features the blog in this months issue under their regular Screen Capture slot, you can read the article here, its a well written piece

As ever if there is any news you know of that you think should be featured on the blog or any tutorial you would like to see simply drop us a email.

Its good to be back..
